xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfBoardC: During 2024-25, Board composition of the Company was not in compliance of the provisions of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. As on 31st March, 2025, the Company has vacancy of six (6) Independent Directors. Since the appointment of Independent Directors in the case of all the Government Companies is being made by the Government, multiple requests were made for filling the vacant posts of Independent Directors, however, they are yet to be appointed.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfCompos: The Company was in compliance with Regulation 18 from 01.04.2024 to 27.12.2024. However, after completion of tenure of one independent director on 27.12.2024, the Company has only One (1) Independent Director on its Board. Hence, constitution of the Commitee is not in compliance with the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015 w.e.f. 28.12.2024. As the appointment of Independent Directors in the case of all the Government Companies is being made by the Government, multiple requests were made for filling the vacant posts of 6 Independent Directors, however, they are yet to be appointed. On appointment of requisite number of independent director, the Committee will be reconstituted in compliance with Regulation 18.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfMeetin: Since the Committee is not in valid constitution, the meetings of the Committee could not be conducted during the Quarter. Once the requisite number of independent directors are appointed, the Commiitee will be reconstituted for conducting the meetings in compliance with Regulation 18.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfCompos: The Company was in compliance with Regulation 19 from 01.04.2024 to 27.12.2024. However, after completion of tenure of one independent director on 27.12.2024, the Company has only One (1) Independent Director on its Board. Hence, constitution of the Commitee is not in compliance with the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015 w.e.f. 28.12.2024. As the appointment of Independent Directors in the case of all the Government Companies is being made by the Government, multiple requests were made for filling the vacant posts of 6 Independent Directors, however, they are yet to be appointed. On appointment of requisite number of independent director, the Committee will be reconstituted in compliance with Regulation 19.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfVacanc: Shri C B Ananthakrishnan, Director (Finance) & CFO was entrusted with addl. charge of CMD by the Government w.e.f. 1.8.2022 to 31.08.2024. On completion of his tenure as Director (Finance) & CFO, Dr. D K Sunil was appointed as Chairman & Managing Director (CMD) of the Company w.e.f. 09.09.2024. It may be noted that, Dr. D K Sunil was entrusted with additional charge of CMD w.e.f. 01.09.2024 till 08.09.2024.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company was in receipt of direction from Commissioner of State Tax, Govt of Maharashtra for payment of Rs.2,471 crore under Amnesty Scheme for PSU's announced by Govt of Maharashtra vide Notification No.Maharashtra Act No.XVII of 2025 dated 21st March, 2025 / Official Gazette No. / RNI No. MAHENG/2009/35528 dated 21st March, 2025 (for various period from 1985-86 to 2017-18).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Office of the Joint Commissioner of State Tax (HQ-7), Maharashtra had requested the Company to pay Rs.2,471 crore as full and final settlement towards payment of taxes in line with the Amnesty Scheme for PSU's. In compliance to the same, a sum of Rs. 2470.97 crore has been paid to Govt. of Maharashtra during 24th - 25th Mar 2025. The amount of Rs. 2470.97 crore has been reimbursed to the Company by the Customer. The matter is now settled and closed.
